About Me
Welcome to my personal website!
Professional Introduction:
I’m Qilin Zhang. I have 4+ years of experience in business analytics in both my undergraduate and graduate studies and specialize in working with data through Excel, R studio and Python, especially in the business marketplace and beyond. In my undergraduate studies, I learned more business-friendly knowledge, and in my graduate studies, I learned R Studio and Python in a systematic way to better fit the current era of analyzing and processing data in the big data era.
